key.name: enabled
key.description: When false the filter is removed completely and costs nothing.

key.name: level
key.description: 0 is the darkest allowed level, 1 is no dimming. The mapping to luminance is logarithmic.

key.name: floor
key.description: Luminance fraction shown when the slider is at its far left. 0.01 means 1 % of what the screen shows at the same backlight setting.

key.name: warmth
key.description: Reduces blue and green light. 0 leaves colours alone.

key.name: excluded-monitors
key.description: Connector names (for example HDMI-1) of screens the filter skips.

key.name: dither
key.description: Adds one level of noise at strong dimming to hide colour banding.

key.name: keep-fullscreen-dimmed
key.description: Stops full-screen windows from bypassing the compositor while dimming is on. Without it, games and videos in full screen show at full brightness.

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show a top bar icon while dimming

key.name: dim-toggle
key.description: Also the way back if the screen was made too dark to read.
